metadata.title: Mastering Active & Passive Voice
metadata.description: Learn how to speak like a native by mastering passive voice.
metadata.subject: Spoken English

blocks.title: What is Voice?
blocks.content:
In English, sentences can be [Active|सक्रिय (Subject does action)] or [Passive|निष्क्रिय (Action is done to subject)]. 

For example:
• Active: I eat an apple. (मैं सेब खाता हूँ।)
• Passive: An apple is eaten by me. (सेब मेरे द्वारा खाया जाता है।)

messages.speaker: A
messages.translation_hi: क्या रिपोर्ट पूरी हो गई है? (Passive)
messages.translation_gu: શું રિપોર્ટ પૂર્ણ થઈ ગયો છે? (Passive)

messages.speaker: B
messages.translation_hi: हाँ, मैंने कल इसे पूरा कर लिया था। (Active)
messages.translation_gu: હા, મેં ગઈકાલે તેને પૂર્ણ કરી દીધો હતો. (Active)

messages.speaker: A
messages.text: Will it be [submitted|जमा करना] to the client today?
messages.translation_hi: क्या यह आज क्लाइंट को जमा की जाएगी? (Passive)
messages.translation_gu: શું આજે તે ક્લાયન્ટને સબમિટ કરવામાં આવશે? (Passive)

messages.speaker: B
messages.text: Yes, the team is going to [submit|जमा करना] it at 5 PM.
messages.translation_hi: हाँ, टीम इसे शाम 5 बजे जमा करने वाली है। (Active)
messages.translation_gu: હા, ટીમ તેને સાંજે 5 વાગ્યે સબમિટ કરવા જઈ રહી છે. (Active)

blocks.title: Practice Time
blocks.question: Change to passive voice: 'You must submit the form before Friday.'
options: The form must submitted before Friday.
The form must be submitted before Friday.
The form must submit before Friday.
blocks.explanation: Modal passive uses 'must be + past participle', so 'must be submitted' is correct.
